name: Six Senses Laamu
positioning: Over-water and beachfront villa resort on Olhuveli Island in the Maldives' remote Laamu Atoll
best_for: Snorkelers, divers and surfers wanting a house reef and a surf break
Couples wanting an over-water or beachfront villa

facts.text: The resort is on the remote Laamu Atoll in the southern Maldives, a seaplane flight away from Male.
The resort is on Olhuveli Island.
All villas make the most of natural materials and are designed for space and privacy.
Surf pros from Tropicsurf offer a surf package for beginners.
Dolphins, rays and parrotfish swim along the resort's shores.
The Sunset Dolphin Cruise is on a private dhoni.
Coral gardens lie a stone's throw from the Chill Lounge & Bar.
The reef at the resort glows with coral spawning when the moon cycle is right.

highlights.text: Guests choose an over-water villa or a beachfront villa among lush vegetation.
Guests can snorkel the house reef and surf the Yin Yang break.
The Maldives Underwater Initiative, a marine conservation initiative, is based at the resort in collaboration with The Manta Trust, Blue Marine Foundation and Olive Ridley Project.
The Sunset Dolphin Cruise is on a private dhoni.

considerations.text: The resort is on a remote atoll in the southern Maldives, reached by a seaplane flight from Male.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
